description: This pie chart, from the paper "Nondeterministic Polynomial-time Problem Challenge: An Ever-Scaling Reasoning Benchmark for LLMs," visually represents four core components of the benchmark, each occupying one quadrant of the circle. The chart is divided into four equal slices, each approximately 25% of the total. The top-left slice is yellow and labeled "Complexity," featuring a small icon of a ladder. The top-right slice is light blue and labeled "Instance," marked with a shield icon containing a checkmark. The bottom-right slice is green and labeled "Coverage," accompanied by an icon of a globe with gears. The bottom-left slice is red and labeled "Scalable Oversight," with an icon resembling a clipboard with a checkmark. The chart does not include a legend or percentage labels within the slices, and no segments are visually emphasized or exploded. The labels for the other two categories, "Uncrashable" and "General," appear in callout boxes outside the pie chart, suggesting they are related but not part of the primary breakdown shown.
